ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to the exquisite 30a Serenity Sands, an awe-inspiring newly constructed luxury home situated in the vibrant heart of Gulf Place. Whether you're seeking a haven for family reunions or a haven for corporate retreats, this remarkable residence promises an unparalleled fusion of opulence and comfort. Nestled just a stone's throw away from Gulf Place/Dune Allen, renowned as one of 30a's destinations, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of convenience, with shopping, dining, nightly entertainment, and an array of activities at your fingertips. The home has an abundance of spaces designed for both entertaining and relaxation within 30a Serenity Sands. From the expansive kitchen island that graciously accommodates up to 14 guests to the irresistible allure of the heated pool and spa, every facet of this home is meticulously crafted to elevate your beach getaway experience. Step outside onto the multiple levels, balconies, and outdoor patio spaces, where the gentle sea breeze invites you to unwind amidst the serene surroundings. Whether you're basking in the camaraderie of group gatherings or seeking moments of solitude, 30a Serenity Sands offers a plethora of options to suit your every mood. For those with larger groups yearning for double the fun, consider booking the adjacent property and elevate your stay to new heights of enjoyment and camaraderie!

*** NEW CONSTRUCTION ***
*** PRIVATE HEATED POOL & SPA ***
***GOLF CART INCLUDED***
*** PEAK-A-BOO VIEWS OF THE GULF ***

ABOUT THE AREA: Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow folks down with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, plentiful green spaces, and park benches to sit and enjoy the views. This community features some of 30A's most popular restaurants, like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Whether you are looking for an epic culinary experience, a fun feast for the whole family or just grab a quick bite to take to the beach, Gulf Place has it all.

BEACH ACCESS: This lovely home is 3 blocks from Ed Walline Public Beach Access. Hop on your bikes and take a stroll down to the beach!

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 20
• Bedroom 1 – King Bed (1), ensuite bath – 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 – 2 Sets of Triple XL Twin Bunk, shared Bath – 1st Floor
• Bedroom 3 – King Bed, ensuite bath – 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 – King Bed, ensuite bath – 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 5 – King Bed, ensuite bath – 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 6 – King Bed, ensuite bath – 3rd Floor
• Bedroom 7 – 1 Set of Triple XL Twin Bunk – 3rd Floor
Queen sleeper sofa---3rd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Heated Pool & Spa
• Private Back Yard
• 3 Blocks to the Beach
• 4 Adult Bikes
• Game Room on 3rd Floor
• Outdoor Entertainment Area
• Grill
• Smart TV's throughout the house
• Full Size Washer & Dryers on each floor
• Chef's Kitchen with enormous island, 2 dishwashers
• Coffee Maker - Drip & Pod
• Full linen package: bedding & bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida’s famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you’ll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Please note: A queen sleeper sofa is located on the third floor but is not pictured in the current photos.
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool heat is $150 per day and must be added for the entire length of stay. No exceptions. Tampering with pool equipment will result in a $200 charge.

Parking Details:
- There is room to park 4 vehicles.

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff. We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: This house is fantastic! The location is amazing! We really liked that it’s a less busy area than the Seaside and Rosemary areas with short distance to both 98 and 30A! The beach is an easy 3 block walk with easy beach access. You can walk to several restaurants and a short drive to many more, some you can take your LSV to. The beds were all very comfortable and we loved the different levels! The rental service was great and had such fast response to all our questions and needs! I would highly recommend them! We can’t wait to return to this fabulous home and make more memories!

reviews.text: Our group of 14 women stayed here and we had the best time. Hollie and Breanna were great host - extremely communicative and easy to work with. The house itself besides being clean and spectacular was in a great location on 30A - 5 minute walk to amazing restaurants and cafes, 5 min walk to the beach or 2 min on the golf cart, and quick uber rides to Seaside and Grayton. I'd definitely recommend staying here if you're planning a trip with a big group. Super convenient, clean beautiful pool in the back, and really gracious host! Thank you for an amazing trip.

reviews.author: Lynn L.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text:
Serenity Sands and 30A Beach Girls exceeded our expectations in every way. This brand-new property is nothing short of spectacular. The location is unbeatable - with the beach, shops, and restaurants just about a 5-minute walk away. Bikes and a golf cart were available, but we often preferred to enjoy the short walk. Whether you want to soak up the sun or explore local dining options, everything is right at your doorstep. 

The property itself is pristine and beautifully designed, with every detail reflecting quality and style. The high-end furnishings are modern, comfortable, and thoughtfully chosen, creating a space that feels both inviting and luxurious. It's clear that a lot of care went into making this home as aesthetically pleasing as it is functional.

Despite being close to all the action, the home offers a quiet, private retreat. The outdoor pool area feels like an oasis, perfect for relaxation. The beds and bedding are incredibly comfortable, ensuring we all slept soundly every night. The kitchen is impressively well-equipped, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and most everything you could possibly need for cooking. Being a brand-new property, everything is fresh and immaculate, which added to the overall experience. 

If you're looking for a place that combines luxury, comfort, and an unbeatable location, this is it. We can't recommend Serenity Sands enough and will definitely be returning!
